name: CompoundUni
fix_description: In priceInternal, uses manipulable on-chain price/balance values. Fix: use TWAP oracle or add flash-loan protection.
difficulty_reasoning: This exploit is a flash-loan-assisted multi-step price/accounting manipulation against a specific UniswapV2 pair using repeated token transfers plus skim calls before swapping back.
